                            Do not place a comma between [ar] and [v].

We hope to share the beauty of classical literature with you through this platform, allowing you to appreciate the rhythm of poetry and the elegance of prose, while also gaining a deeper understanding of the poet's mood and the profound meaning of their works. Every week, we will present you with classic works of ancient Chinese poetry, covering literary masterpieces from the Tang and Song dynasties to the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. At the same time, we will also introduce the great ancient Chinese poets, allowing you to understand their legendary works and their biographical backgrounds. In addition, we will also take you into the world of famous works and the wisdom of ancient Eastern books. Whether it's British style or Eastern philosophy, we will use vivid interpretation and in-depth analysis to take you through the beauty of these classic works and inspire you to think and appreciate literature. Poetic Rhyme and Ancient Style welcomes all audiences who love literature, poetry, and prose. Whether you are a literary enthusiast, student, teacher, or a friend interested in Chinese culture, we hope to bring you the enjoyment of beauty and enlightenment of knowledge. Please subscribe to our channel and immerse yourself in the ocean of classical literature with us!
                            [2] = a detailed description of [1] with specific imagery details.

                            [4] = a detailed description of the compositions.
